<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccidentNotification" name="Accident notification"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_InsuredPerson" name="Insured person" processRef="Process_InsuredPerson"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EducationalInstitution" name="School or university"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CompetentDirectorate" name="Competent directorate"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyWork" name="Notify work accident" sourceRef="Task_IP_NotifyWorkAccident" targetRef="StartEvent_Emp_Notification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyNearMiss" name="Notify near-miss" sourceRef="Task_IP_NotifyNearMiss" targetRef="StartEvent_Emp_Notification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyHazard" name="Notify serious risk or defect" sourceRef="Task_IP_NotifyHazard" targetRef="StartEvent_Emp_Notification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentReport" name="Report accident" sourceRef="Task_IP_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_CompetentDirectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedReport" name="Report accident" sourceRef="Task_IP_ReportSelfEmployed" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateReport" name="Written accident report" sourceRef="Task_IP_ReportPrivate" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_IP_ReportFatality" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LabourReport" name="Report fatality or serious injury" sourceRef="Task_EMP_ReportLabour" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerInsurerReport" name="Report accident within five days" sourceRef="Task_EMP_ReportInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EducationReport" name="Report accident in triplicate within five days" sourceRef="Participant_EducationalInstitution" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_InsuredPerson" name="Insured person: accident notification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IP" name="Accident, near-miss or hazard occurs"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IP_Record" name="Record event circumstances"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IP_EventType" name="Event type"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_NotifyWorkAccident" name="Notify employer immediately of work accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_NotifyNearMiss" name="Notify employer immediately of near-miss"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_NotifyHazard" name="Notify employer immediately of serious risk or protection defect"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IP_EventJoin" name="Notifications made"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IP_Student" name="Student or schoolchild?" default="Flow_IP_11"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IP_Merge_Student" name="Merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IP_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed?" default="Flow_IP_15"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_ReportSelfEmployed" name="Report accident involving self and employees to accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IP_Merge_SelfEmployed" name="Merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IP_PrivateInsurance" name="Private insurance applies?" default="Flow_IP_19"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_ReportPrivate" name="Report accident in writing immediately to private insurer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IP_Fatality" name="Fatality?" default="Flow_IP_22"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_ReportFatality" name="Report fatality within three days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IP_Done" name="No further reporting required"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IP_PrivateReported" name="Private insurer notified"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IP_FatalityReported" name="Fatality reported"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IP" targetRef="Task_IP_Record"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_2" sourceRef="Task_IP_Record" targetRef="Gateway_IP_EventType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_3" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_EventType" targetRef="Task_IP_NotifyWorkAccident">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${workAccident}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_4" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_EventType" targetRef="Task_IP_NotifyNearMiss">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nearMiss}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_5" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_EventType" targetRef="Task_IP_NotifyHazard">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${seriousRiskOrDefect}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_6" sourceRef="Task_IP_NotifyWorkAccident" targetRef="Gateway_IP_EventJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_7" sourceRef="Task_IP_NotifyNearMiss" targetRef="Gateway_IP_EventJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_8" sourceRef="Task_IP_NotifyHazard" targetRef="Gateway_IP_EventJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_9" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_EventJoin" targetRef="Gateway_IP_Student"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_10" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_Student" targetRef="Task_IP_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${studentOrPupil}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_11" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_Student" targetRef="Gateway_IP_Merge_Student"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_12" sourceRef="Task_IP_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_IP_Merge_Student"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_13" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_Merge_Student" targetRef="Gateway_IP_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_14" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_SelfEmployed" targetRef="Task_IP_ReportSelfEmployed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${selfEmployed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_15" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_SelfEmployed" targetRef="Gateway_IP_Merge_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_16" sourceRef="Task_IP_ReportSelfEmployed" targetRef="Gateway_IP_Merge_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_17" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_Merge_SelfEmployed" targetRef="Gateway_IP_PrivateInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_18" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_PrivateInsurance" targetRef="Task_IP_ReportPrivate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${privateInsurance}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_19" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_PrivateInsurance" targetRef="EndEvent_IP_Done"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_20" sourceRef="Task_IP_ReportPrivate" targetRef="Gateway_IP_Fatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_21" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_Fatality" targetRef="Task_IP_ReportFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${fatality}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_22" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_Fatality" targetRef="EndEvent_IP_PrivateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_23" sourceRef="Task_IP_ReportFatality" targetRef="EndEvent_IP_FatalityReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer: accident handling and reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Emp_Notification" name="Accident notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Emp_Notification" messageRef="Message_AccidentNotification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EMP_Assess" name="Assess reported event"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EMP_WorkAccident" name="Work accident?" default="Flow_EMP_4"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EMP_Serious" name="Fatality or serious injury?" default="Flow_EMP_6"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EMP_Emergency" name="Reported to emergency services?" default="Flow_EMP_8"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EMP_ReportLabour" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EMP_Merge_Serious" name="Merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EMP_InsurerReport" name="Insured person killed or unable to work for three days?" default="Flow_EMP_12"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EMP_ReportInsurer" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_EMP_Recorded" name="Event recorded"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_EMP_Reported" name="Accident insurer reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_EMP_NoInsurerReport" name="No insurer report required"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Emp_Notification" targetRef="Task_EMP_Assess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_2" sourceRef="Task_EMP_Assess" targetRef="Gateway_EMP_WorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_3" sourceRef="Gateway_EMP_WorkAccident" targetRef="Gateway_EMP_Serious">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${workAccident}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_4" sourceRef="Gateway_EMP_WorkAccident" targetRef="EndEvent_EMP_Recorded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_5" sourceRef="Gateway_EMP_Serious" targetRef="Gateway_EMP_Emergency">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${fatalOrSeriousInjury}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_6" sourceRef="Gateway_EMP_Serious" targetRef="Gateway_EMP_Merge_Serious"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_7" sourceRef="Gateway_EMP_Emergency" targetRef="Gateway_EMP_Merge_Serious">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reportedToEmergencyServices}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_8" sourceRef="Gateway_EMP_Emergency" targetRef="Task_EMP_ReportLabour"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_9" sourceRef="Task_EMP_ReportLabour" targetRef="Gateway_EMP_Merge_Serious"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_10" sourceRef="Gateway_EMP_Merge_Serious" targetRef="Gateway_EMP_InsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_11" sourceRef="Gateway_EMP_InsurerReport" targetRef="Task_EMP_ReportInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${insuredKilledOrIncapacitated}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_12" sourceRef="Gateway_EMP_InsurerReport" targetRef="EndEvent_EMP_NoInsurerReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EMP_13" sourceRef="Task_EMP_ReportInsurer" targetRef="EndEvent_EMP_Reported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
